comment: Per-board notes from reading the boards by hand (docs/router-ceiling.md). 'class' overrides the census's class where its rule is too coarse; the table marks it with *.

obsilab__Quanta75__Quanta75_BareRP2040_J.note: every new finding is our I2C1-SDA track inside the '0bsilab' knockout plate as KiCad draws it (stand-in font, 4 mm past the cached glyphs)

obsilab__Quanta75__Quanta75_RP2040Stamp_.note: the same plate (shorts, bridge) and 'Quanta75' in Urbanist SemiBold 0.105 mm from Row6

transistorfet__computie__k30-SBC.note: J1.39 starved only after the solid step's one round; one more round: clean (checked by hand)

tzarc__keyboards__ghoul.note: RN3.3 starved only after the solid step's one round; three more rounds (RN3.1, RN3.2): clean (checked by hand)

MbFredys__PCB-Modular-Multi-Protocol-Hub.note: 9 of 12: the X2SON-4 regulators' corner pads (U2, U3, U6), custom pads joined at a 0.148 mm anchor that lies within the class clearance of the centre pad: no legal node in the contact

briskspirit__Sisu_SSE-9__Sisu_SSE-9.note: 16 of 18: dome-switch centre pads (4 mm) inside a 6.2 mm ring of another net, the designer's via in each; route mode admits only small pads. Also skew 5 (a USB skew rule over 5 nets)

ikajdan__katia__katia.note: input's: the halves' GND (the designer's too). Ours: USB_D's 0.4 mm clearance walls J7/J8's 0.5 mm row, a clearance the project rates a warning; the minimum-clearance step did not run (work)

byrantech__laptop__keyboard.note: U2 aQFN-73 inner pads: VSS_PA (F23) and RESET (AC9), whose way out is narrower than the class (the designer necks down to 0.127 mm)

byrantech__laptop__motherboard.note: WLCSP-9 U7/U13: the middle balls need a via in the pad and the designer's 0.4/0.3 via breaks the board's annular minimum (the designer's board has annular_width 199); the edge balls of power nets have no node

bismarx-v1__Sumec-MiniSumo__SUMEC_MK_IV.note: input's: R12/C19 swapped GND/SHLD as on the designer's board; IC2.11/IC3.11: a 0.45 mm pad no track of the High Power class (2.0 mm) enters

ebastler__osprey__osprey_rev_a.note: AE1.1, the antenna's feed, inside the footprint's own copper graphic; c2 at the aQFN

Seeed-Studio__OSHW-reCamera-Series__reCa.note: MIC1's GND pads inside its own copper ring; the designer's board leaves 3 of them

hackclub__OnBoard__woagboard.note: an F.Cu GND zone piece the designer's board leaves apart too (two GND zones on F.Cu intersect)

Twisted-Fields__rp2040-motor-controller_.note: two RP2040 QFN-56 at 0.2/0.2 in a 0.4 mm row (an exact fit): 8 pads' escape pockets closed on the 0.1 mm lattice (no margin of zero), the rest crossing or closed ways

vd-rd__sbc_allwinner_a13__module.note: ddr-dm1 under the SoC; findings: a GND track in a keepout and its dangling end

CDFER__Business-Cards__WLED_Matrix.note: LDO1.2 (SOT-23) has no node; what walls it is not shown by the diagnostics
